Appellant/Petitioner(s)
 Through :- Mr. Anil Sharma, Advocate vice  Mr. R.P. Sharma, Advocate.
 v/s Union Territory of J&K and others .....Respondent(s)
 Through :- Mr. Ravinder Gupta, AAG for 1-5.

Mrs. Monika Kohli, Sr. AAG for 9 & 10.
 CORAM:
 HON'BLE THE CHIEF JUSTICE  HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE RAHUL BHARTI, JUDGE  ORDER 17.04.2023 (Open Court) (Per-N. Kotiswar Singh-CJ)
1.

The petitioners have filed the present writ petition seeking direction to the respondents to forebear from encroaching upon and constructing road in the proprietary land of the petitioners falling under survey no. 1568 measuring 47 kanal 9 marlas situated in village Dodasan Bala tehsil Thana Mandi district Rajouri.

In the said petition, a further direction is sought unto the respondents to acquire the land by following a due process of law and make payment of compensation for the land and for collateral damage to the fruit bearing and other trees standing thereon.

2. This Court vide order dated 24.12.2021 had observed that more than 2 kanals of the land of the petitioners have fallen in alignment of Saim Samit to Ghai Sayedan road constructed by the PWD (R&B) Department.
It has also been observed in the said order that the respondents have utilized the said road in the year 2019 without acquiring it and without paying any compensation to the petitioners.

3. In the order (supra), this Court also noticed the submission made by Mr. S. S. Nanda, learned Mushtaq Ahmed Shah And Others vs Union Territory Of J&K And Others on 17 April, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/131082971/

Senior AAG that the land has come in the alignment of the aforesaid road and that the Collector Land Acquisition has already initiated the process of acquisition thereby taking up the matter with the Executive Engineer, PWD (R&B) Department Division, Rajouri for placing the necessary indent and once the indent is received, the land would be acquired and compensation shall be determined as per The Right to Fair Compensation & Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation &
Re-settlement Act, 2013 and paid to the landowners.

Right to Fair Compensation & Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation &
Re-settlement Act, 2013

sentences.text: 4. This Court also observed in the order (supra) that because of the undue deprivation of the land of the petitioners from the year of 2019 till date or till the date of acquisition, the respondents are liable to pay compensation to the petitioners.

Accordingly, this Court proceeded to direct the Revenue Department to determine the rental compensation for the aforesaid land for the above period within a period of six weeks from the date of passing of this order and also proceeded to direct the PWD (R&B) Department to make arrangement for payment of the said amount to the petitioners within a further period of one month thereafter and granted liberty to the authority to proceed with the acquisition of the land.

5. Pursuant to the directions of this Court dated 24.12.2021, the Additional Deputy Commissioner,
Rajouri has written to the Executive Engineer, PWD (R&B) Division, Rajouri that the Collector Land Acquisition/Sub Divisional Magistrate Thanamandi vide his Office no. SDM/TMR/222-23 dated 19.10.2022 has furnished the details of assessment of rental compensation for the land measuring 04 kanals 10 marlas and 07 sarsai @ Rs. 13,335/- per annum total amounting to Rs. 40,005/- for the year 2019, 2020 and 2021 and the said rentals have been assessed on the basis of average production of land in question.

entities.text: Collector Land Acquisition/Sub Divisional Magistrate Thanamandi
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
In the said communication, Additional Deputy Commissioner,
Rajouri also requested the Executive Engineer, PWD (R&B) Division, Rajouri to make arrangement for payment of the said amount to the petitioners as per the directions passed by this Court in terms of an order dated 24.12.2021.

In this regard, we have also noticed that the earlier order dated 09.11.2022 also reiterated the directions passed in an order dated 24.12.2021 regarding payment of rental compensation to the petitioners.

6. It has been submitted by Mr. Ravinder Gupta, learned AAG appearing for the PWD that the Public Works Departments is not in receipt of any communication dated 04.11.2022 written by Additional Deputy Commissioner, Rajouri to the Executive Engineer PWD (R&B) Division, Rajouri for release of the rental compensation.

The communication dated 04.11.2022 produced by Mrs.
Monika Kohli, learned Sr. AAG is taken on record and we, accordingly, direct Mr. Ravinder Gupta,
learned AAG appearing for the PWD to immediately release the rental compensation in favour of the petitioners in terms of said communication dated 04.11.2022.
The amount shall be released preferably within a period of four weeks.

7. As regards the initiation of land acquisition proceedings, let the indent be deposited by the Public Works Department through the office of the Additional Deputy Commissioner, Rajouri within a period of four weeks so that necessary process for acquisition under the Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in the Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Re-settlement Act, 2013 can commence without any further delay.
